compliance.rule: 100% of embedding must run in the user's browser
compliance.method: env.allowRemoteModels=false + Chromium --host-resolver-rules='MAP * ~NOTFOUND, EXCLUDE 127.0.0.1', then encode a fresh text in a new tab

compliance.rule: server must not precompute vectors or replay stored results
compliance.method: Inspect request path: server has no embedding model and keeps no answer cache; /api/import only stores vectors sent by the tab, /api/search recomputes the query vector in the tab for every request
compliance.observed: stepfun/server/app.py contains no model weights or cached result set

compliance.rule: storage and retrieval must go through seekdb, no client-memory fallback
compliance.method: Stopped seekdb while the app was running, then clicked Search
compliance.observed: UI: "检索失败：/api/search -> HTTP 500"; backend log: Can't connect to MySQL server on '127.0.0.1'; no local fallback results shown

compliance.rule: keyword and vector ranking must be fused inside seekdb
compliance.method: One /api/search call builds a body with query.match.content + knn.query_vector and executes DBMS_HYBRID_SEARCH.SEARCH once
compliance.observed: generated SQL uses (ifnull(_fts._keyword_score,0) + ifnull(_vs._semantic_score,0)) AS _score; web/app.js has no sort/merge code
